name: BRABUS: One Second Wow
overview: One of Germany's most talked-about luxury brands shows it all! From Beverly Hills to Bottrop: power couple Constantin and Mili travel the world to shape its future. Meanwhile, the tech wizards around Jörn have to get the latest designs ready for their global fashion show for supercars. What does it take to build a legacy? How do love and leadership collide? And what price is there to pay?
